an6.119:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato tapusso, gahapati tathāgate niṭṭhaṃgato amataddaso amataṃ sacchikatvā irīyati.
an6.119:1.3: buddhe aveccappasādena, dhamme aveccappasādena, saṅghe aveccappasādena, ariyena sīlena, ariyena ñāṇena, ariyāya vimuttiyā.
an6.119:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato tapusso gahapati tathāgate niṭṭhaṃ gato amataddaso amataṃ sacchikatvā irīyatīti.
